printingGuide.title: Printing Guide for Connect the Dots Worksheets
printingGuide.setting1: Use letter size paper (8.5" x 11") for standard printing
printingGuide.setting2: Set print quality to "high" or "best" for clear dots
printingGuide.setting3: Select "actual size" (not scaled) in print options
printingGuide.setting4: Conserve ink: Choose black and white printing.
printingGuide.setting5: Choose portrait orientation for most designs
printingGuide.tip1: Download the PDF version for the best printing results
printingGuide.tip2: For younger children, print at 125% scale for larger dots
printingGuide.tip3: Use thicker paper (cardstock) for longer-lasting activities
printingGuide.tip4: Save ink by deselecting "background graphics" in print settings

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Are your connect the dots printables really free?
faq.a1: Yes, all our connect the dots printables are completely free to download and print. We don't require any payment or subscription to access our basic printables. Some premium designs may be available for a small fee, but they're clearly marked.
faq.q2: What file formats are available for download?
faq.a2: All our connect the dots printables are available in PDF format, which is ideal for printing. Many designs also come in high-resolution PNG image format. The PDF format is recommended for the best printing results as it preserves the layout and quality regardless of your device or printer.
faq.q3: Can I use these printables for commercial purposes?
faq.a3: Our connect the dots printables are for personal and educational use only. They cannot be used for commercial purposes, including selling the printables or using them in products for sale. If you're a teacher, you may use them in your classroom and distribute them to your students.
faq.q4: How do I create a custom connect the dots printable?
faq.a4: You can create custom connect the dots printables using our generator tool. Simply upload an image, choose the number of dots and difficulty level, and our tool will convert your image into a connect the dots worksheet. You can then download it in PDF or image format for printing.
faq.q5: Do you have connect the dots printables for adults?
faq.a5: Yes, we have a large collection of connect the dots printables designed specifically for adults. These include more complex designs with hundreds of dots, intricate patterns, and detailed images that provide a relaxing, meditative activity. You can find them in our "Adult Connect the Dots" category.

aiTech.title: Our AI "Dot-to-Dot" Generation Technology
aiTech.body: We are currently in Beta. Our AI generator works best with clear outlines and medium-complexity subjects. While it may not yet handle ultra-complex 2000-dot scenes perfectly on the first try, your subscription directly funds our server costs and algorithm improvements. If a generation isn't to your liking, your generous credit balance allows for multiple iterations to get the perfect dot-to-dot result.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.a1: One credit is consumed whenever you generate a new dot-to-dot worksheet using our AI tool. Regular downloads of our pre-made library remain free or ad-supported.
faq.q2: Can I sell the generated dot-to-dot worksheets?
faq.a2: Yes! With the Monthly Creator and Annual Master plans, you receive a full commercial license. You can include these worksheets in your books for Amazon KDP, sell digital PDFs on Etsy, or use them in your own classroom materials.
faq.q3: Why is there a credit system?
faq.a3: AI generation requires significant GPU computing power. The credit system allows us to keep the basic tool free for everyone while providing professional-grade power to those who need it.
faq.q4: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.a4: No hidden tricks. You can cancel your subscription at any time via your account dashboard. You will continue to have access to premium features until the end of your billing period.
